title: CountIf with a predicate
prompt: Implement `static int CountIf<T>(IEnumerable<T> items, Func<T, bool> predicate)` counting matching elements; null items → 0.

tests.name: normal
tests.code:
Cj.Eq(Solution.CountIf(new[] { 1, 2, 3, 4 }, x => x % 2 == 0), 2, "two evens");
Cj.Eq(Solution.CountIf(new[] { "a", "bb", "c" }, s => s.Length > 1), 1, "one long string");
tests.hint: The delegate decides membership; the method just counts.

tests.name: edges
tests.hint: Empty, null, and reject-all all return 0 without exceptions.
